typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

description.description: Description for the prompt containing information on how and when it should be used.

rawTemplate.description:
The string representation of the prompt, where parameters are not yet set. Parameters are conventionally
signalled with double brackets, i.e. {{parameter}}. If such parameters are in the input `template`,
they will be used as keys to #parameters.

templateFile.description: The file where the prompt is defined.

parameters.description:
This prompt's parameters. Parameters can be accessed with #params, set with #setParam and #setParams, reset
with #resetParams or renamed with #renameParam and #renameParams.

defaultExamples.description:
A list of default examples that will be injected into the prompt config at `{{EXAMPLES}}. If examples _are_ provided
within the model configuration template, those will be injected instead and the default examples defined here will
not be used.

staticExamples.description: A list of examples that will _always_ be injected into the prompt config at `{{EXAMPLES}}`.

promptCreatorType.description:
The type of prompt creator {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.REA.ModelInference.Prompt.Creator} to use when generating the prompt. This will be used to format custom
examples for the prompt that will be passed to the model.

title: Base type for prompts passed to LLMs
name: Genai.Prompt
